best_ability.name: Binding Word
best_ability.scaling: 110 base damage · ×2.44 per Spirit Power (deadlock.wiki — the assets API lists these scalings swapped with Alchemical Flask)
best_ability.why: The numbers decide it: Binding Word's ×2.44 scaling is the highest in Warden's kit by a factor of four over the flask (60 base, ×0.63 — wiki values; the API's scaling file has the two abilities' numbers swapped, the wiki and Mobalytics agree with each other). It also immobilizes for 1.75s and silences at Tier 3 — the nuke CCs its own target.

swaps.why: Cleanse Threadsap stacks before she steals the Spirit Power this whole build runs on.
Survive the dive window; your damage is back-loaded, theirs is not.
Healing cut beats max-HP shred when they out-sustain the burst.
Ground the kite — a rooted carry eats the full rotation.

nuke.damage_math: Binding Word: 110 base + ×2.44 scaling × 167 Spirit Power (final loadout Spirit Power from items: 145 flat + 15% (Boundless Spirit) ≈ 167 effective) = ~517 damage on a target that also eats a 1.75s immobilize (silence at Tier 3) — before Mystic Burst's proc, Escalating Exposure's stacking amp, and the +20% bullet damage Warden deals to trapped targets at Tier 1. For comparison, Alchemical Flask at the same Spirit Power: 60 + ×0.63 × 167 ≈ 165. That gap is why the word is the nuke.
nuke.kit_synergy: Every imbue goes on Binding Word. Surge of Power feeds the ×2.44 scaling, cooldown compression (Superior + Transcendent) drops the word’s cooldown toward spam territory, and Echo Shard lets you curse a second hero before the first one’s chains break. Mystic Burst in the opener is deliberate: it procs on the word’s cast, taxing every curse further.
